spark.name: Hawk
spark.text: Passive: 3 damage to a random enemy at the end of your turn. Awaken: 8 damage to a random enemy.

splinter.name: Splinter
splinter.text: Planted with a charge of 4. Passive: damage equal to its charge to ALL enemies at the end of your turn, then its charge falls by 1. Awaken: twice its charge to ALL enemies.

ward.name: Bear
ward.text: Passive: 2 Barrier at the end of your turn. Awaken: 5 Barrier.

hollow.name: Elder
hollow.text: Planted with a charge of 6; charges by 6 more at the end of each of your turns (Spirit adds to that). Awaken: damage equal to its charge to the enemy with the least HP.

prism.name: Owl
prism.text: Passive: gain 1 Mana at the start of your turn. Awaken: gain 2 Mana.
